name: VI ADVI Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for variational inference and ADVI CDGs.

operations.name: Monitor ELBO Convergence
operations.intent: Check whether variational optimization has plateaued before posterior use.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a convergence check to see whether the optimization objective is still improving too much.

rewrite.before_summary: ELBO values flow into optimization without explicit plateau evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An ELBO convergence monitor is inserted after objective evaluation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds stopping-quality evidence for variational optimization.

operations.name: Analyze Gradient Variance
operations.intent: Detect noisy stochastic gradients after reparameterized sampling.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for gradients that vary too much across samples.

rewrite.before_summary: Reparameterized samples feed gradient estimates directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A gradient-variance analyzer is inserted after reparameterization.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds evidence that stochastic gradients are stable enough to optimize.

operations.name: Detect Posterior Collapse
operations.intent: Flag latent dimensions whose KL contribution has effectively vanished.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for latent variables that the variational posterior has stopped using.

rewrite.before_summary: Latent shape allocation proceeds without explicit collapse evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A posterior-collapse detector is inserted after shape allocation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds latent-use evidence before interpreting the variational posterior.

operations.name: Check Step Size Stability
operations.intent: Detect unstable optimizer step sizes after variational optimization updates.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for optimizer steps that fluctuate too much.

rewrite.before_summary: Optimizer updates flow downstream without step stability evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A step-size stability check is inserted after the optimizer.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds optimizer health evidence for the variational fit.

audit.rationale: sciona-atoms owns ADVI and advanced VI CDGs that map to matcher VI/ADVI runtime rules.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make variational inference pipelines report convergence, gradient stability, latent collapse, and optimizer stability.

references.title: Matcher VI/ADVI expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/vi_advi.py.
